_doc: UK tracker rows. Update by hand (or a scheduled job that uses official affiliate product feeds/APIs, not page scraping). price=null means show 'Price TBC - check retailer'. stock: in_stock | low | out | preorder | unknown | not_listed. last_checked is ISO 8601 UTC. Never type a price you have not seen on the retailer's own page.
